journal.title: Digital laboratory opened
journal.text: Created the first public-safe catalogue structure. Exact author formulas remain outside the public repository.

journal.title: Personal exclusions recorded
journal.text: Lavender and cassia are excluded from the principal masculine signature direction.

journal.title: Controlled evaluation protocol
journal.text: Prepare blotters, record opening / 30 min / 4 h / 24 h observations, and promote only tested changes into a new version.

knowledge.title: From note pyramid to evaporation curve
knowledge.summary: Treat top, heart and base as a communication model; actual evaporation and perception overlap continuously.

knowledge.title: Why dilution matters
knowledge.summary: Materials can smell radically different neat and in dilution. Controlled dilutions improve accuracy, repeatability and safety.

knowledge.title: Building a signature accord
knowledge.summary: A signature is a repeatable relationship between materials, not simply one strong ingredient used everywhere.

knowledge.title: Maturation vs maceration
knowledge.summary: Keep terminology precise and record what changes over time rather than assuming longer ageing always means better perfume.

knowledge.title: Blotter evaluation protocol
knowledge.summary: Use consistent timing, coded samples and side-by-side controls to reduce memory bias.

knowledge.title: Essential-oil safety baseline
knowledge.summary: Identity, chemotype, supplier documentation, oxidation state and current dermal limits matter before skin use.
